Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 6: the slip of [[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“[Pilot] 2. While piloting a [Republic] starship at a battleground, forfeit +1 and your Force drains are +1 here. Anything he pilots is manuever +1 and immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if all your pilot characters here are clones and/or Jedi).”), word for word the text of [[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5)]]. The label under the slip reads “Rebel Pilot (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>bb70257deeb8f4e3a728b1dc233dca01e96e3f6b8124e95ed04ad3a8f75e98d3</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[402, 58, 586, 304]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B6).
